scientific_limitations: Only F_q-rational singular points are classified; nonrational points and global irreducibility remain unaddressed.
At ordinary points the number of local rational branches and the delta invariant are determined; at critical repeated-tangent points only the initial form and its tangent multiplicities are asserted.
The result does not prove any of the global smoothness conjectures for this pencil.
title: Frobenius-valuation trichotomy for rational singularities of plane-filling curves
